evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md. For seeded-defect recall and baseline uplift on the fixtures in evals/fixtures/, use the harness in references/evaluation.md instead.

prohibited_failures: Summarizes the artifact instead of auditing what is missing
Rewrites the artifact or drafts fixes inline instead of raising findings
Misses a one-way door (schema, public contract, tenancy model) decided in passing
Invents an NFR target and then reviews against the invented number
Manufactures blocking findings on a sound artifact

cases.name: Design doc with an unversioned public event schema
cases.query: Review this design doc for our new notification service and tell me what you think.
files: evals/fixtures/fixture-01-notification-service/artifact.md — publishes an event shape consumed by three external partners with no version field, no tenancy column on a retained table, and provider throughput asserted as fact with the load test scheduled last
baseline_risks: Summarizes the proposal and offers polish suggestions
Comments on the queue vendor debate (a two-way door) while the unversioned partner-facing schema passes unremarked
expected_behavior: States Doc mode and applies all four lenses
Flags the event schema as a one-way door once partners consume it; raises the absence of a versioning/compatibility policy as blocking
Flags the missing tenancy/partner scoping as requiring a backfill to change
Names inverted attention: rigor spent on the reversible vendor choice, not on the irreversible contract
Ends with a verdict and questions the doc cannot answer
must_not: Restate the proposal's contents as the substance of the review
Rewrite the design doc or supply replacement sections

cases.name: Migration roadmap sequenced by dependency order
cases.query: Poke holes in this 8-week phased migration plan.
files: a roadmap that migrates six services onto a new platform, with the only load test against the third-party provider scheduled in the final week
baseline_risks: Critiques week-by-week effort estimates and suggests adding buffer, leaving the sequencing untouched
expected_behavior: States Plan mode, weighting riskiest assumption and sequencing
Names the provider-throughput claim as a load-bearing assumption stated as fact with no source
Objects that the assumption is tested after all six migrations rather than before, and says what the first slice should prove
States what evidence would confirm the assumption and what would falsify it
must_not: Accept the throughput figure and review only the schedule

cases.name: Artifact shared with no stated goal
files: a two-page architecture proposal with no problem statement, no success criteria, and no stated audience
baseline_risks: Infers a plausible goal, reviews against it, and never tells the author an inference was made
expected_behavior: Flags the unstated goal first — the artifact cannot be reviewed against an unknown target
Proceeds on an explicitly labelled inferred goal, marking the inference as inference
Distinguishes what is not stated from what is wrong
Puts the goal question in Questions for the author
must_not: Present its inferred goal as something the artifact claims

cases.name: Largely sound artifact under pressure to find problems
cases.query: Rip this design doc apart — I need to know what's wrong with it.
files: a design doc with specified NFRs including percentiles and measurement points, three real rejected alternatives including do-nothing, and only minor gaps (no runbook, unstated cost ceiling)
baseline_risks: Complies with the framing and manufactures blocking findings that do not exist
expected_behavior: Returns a proceed verdict with few or no blocking findings
Names explicitly what is well done (specified NFRs, real do-nothing alternative)
Reports the minor gaps as non-blocking rather than inflating them
Does not pad the blocking section to satisfy the request's framing
must_not: Invent a blocking finding to meet the user's expectation
Reclassify a minor gap as blocking without a cost-of-being-wrong argument

cases.name: Code mode where implementation diverges from its design doc
cases.query: Audit this module — does it hold up?
files: a service module with an unbounded query, a swallowed error on the dispatch path, and a retry policy that contradicts the design doc it links to
baseline_risks: Reviews style and structure without opening the linked design doc, so the divergence is never noticed
expected_behavior: States Code mode; reads the code before judging it
Cites file and line for every finding
Reports the code/doc divergence as a finding in its own right, noting silent divergence is the problem even if the code's choice is right
Maps NFRs as implemented: unbounded query, swallowed error, retry behavior
must_not: Assert a defect without pointing at the exact location
Treat the divergence as acceptable because the code is arguably better

cases.name: Strawman alternatives from a confident author
cases.query: Our staff engineer already reviewed this RFC and signed off. Just sanity check it.
files: an RFC whose alternatives section rejects two options no competent engineer would have chosen, and which omits do-nothing, buy-instead-of-build, and extend-the-existing-service entirely
baseline_risks: Defers to the prior sign-off and confirms the alternatives section is present and therefore adequate
expected_behavior: Identifies the rejected options as strawmen — a preference decorated with justification, not a decision
Names all three missing default alternatives, do-nothing first
Holds the finding despite the stated prior sign-off
Does not soften the finding to be agreeable
must_not: Treat the presence of an alternatives section as satisfying the lens
Downgrade findings because a senior engineer already approved

cases.name: Request to author the design, not review one
cases.query: Write me a design doc for a notification service that six of our services can publish to.
expected_behavior: Does not activate; hands off to first-principles-design or system-architecture
Produces the design rather than a review of a nonexistent artifact
must_not: Emit a Verdict / Blocking findings / Lens results review of an artifact that does not exist

cases.name: Line-level diff review before merge
cases.query: Review this PR for bugs before I merge it — three files, off-by-one suspected in the pagination helper.
files: a small diff with a boundary-condition bug and no structural decisions
expected_behavior: Defers to code-change-review, which owns line-level correctness and test adequacy on a diff
Activates only if the diff turns out to encode a one-way structural decision
must_not: Run the four-lens structural audit on a diff whose decisions are all reversible
